Build123dCreatePlateRequest.description: Arguments of the build123d create_plate tool: a flat rectangular plate with one through hole at each corner. All lengths are in millimetres. Frame: length along X, width along Y, thickness along Z; the plate is centred on the origin in X and Y and its bottom face lies on Z = 0. Besides these bounds, the server rejects geometry where a hole would break an edge (hole_inset_mm <= hole_diameter_mm / 2) or two holes would meet (length_mm or width_mm minus 2 * hole_inset_mm <= hole_diameter_mm).

hole_diameter_mm.description: Diameter of each of the four through holes, in mm.

hole_inset_mm.description: Distance from each plate edge to the centre of the nearest holes, in mm.

length_mm.description: Plate length along X, in mm.

thickness_mm.description: Plate thickness along Z, in mm.

width_mm.description: Plate width along Y, in mm.

Build123dPart.description: Handle to a part built by the build123d tool server. The server keeps no state between calls, so the handle carries the parameters the part is rebuilt from. part_id is derived from those parameters; a handle whose part_id does not match them is rejected.

part_id.description: sha256 of the canonical JSON of plate. Equal parameters give an equal part_id.

plate.description: The create_plate arguments this part was built from.
